### what_to_do_first.details[2]
Sentence: Because stage is missing for about 48% of patients and Pohjanmaa's crude MDT-recorded share—measuring recording practice, not care—is 6.9% (95% CI 4.9–9.6; n=31/449, whose 95% confidence interval includes 6.0%, 893/14873 nationally), the team recommends publishing county recording completeness for stage, drug treatment, and MDT coding while the STM roadmap (measure 3.2.1) plans a national quality registry (2026–2028 decree; 90%-coverage reports by 2029–2031).
